第二天一早，王建新照常巡逻了一圈。骑着马，带着狗，沿着铁丝网走了一遍，对面安安静静的，连个脚印都没有。转了一圈回来，没啥异常。

回到土坯房，他开始琢磨着做点好吃的。

最近物资充足，面也不缺，油也不缺，想吃什么就做什么。他想了想，决定炸点麻花、馓子和油饼。这些东西放得住，做好了能吃好几天，省得顿顿做饭。

先和面。舀了几大碗白面，加糖，加鸡蛋，加酵母，倒水和成面团。面团揉光滑了，盖上湿布醒着。醒面的工夫，他烧了一锅油，油温上来了，面也醒好了。

麻花最难做。把面团搓成长条，两头一拧，折过来再一拧，一个麻花就成了。说起来简单，做起来得有点手艺。王建新上辈子当厨子，炸麻花这事儿干过不少回，手不生了。一个接一个地拧，不一会就拧了一案板。

馓子更费工夫。把面团搓成细条，一根一根的，跟筷子差不多粗，盘在油盆里醒着。醒好了，用筷子挑起来，绷直了，下油锅炸。面条在油锅里定型，炸到金黄，捞出来，又酥又脆。

油饼最简单。面团擀成圆饼，中间划两刀，下油锅炸，两面炸到金黄鼓起来，捞出来控油。

忙忙碌碌，一直到了下午，才算是做完。麻花炸了一大盆，馓子炸了一大盆，油饼也炸了一大盆。满院子都是油炸面食的香味，飘出去老远。

王建新拿起一个油饼咬了一口，外酥里软，香得很。又拿了一根麻花，嘎嘣脆，甜丝丝的。又撕了一块馓子，酥得掉渣。

他给了大毛它们一人一个油饼。五条狗叼着油饼，趴在地上，吃得那叫一个香，尾巴摇得像风车。小狐狸给了它一小块麻花，小家伙两只前爪捧着，小口小口地啃，吃得很美。

王建新喝着奶茶，一边干活一边吃，也没少吃。吃饱了，把剩下的全部收入空间，放在餐厅的柜子里，整整齐齐地码好。

收拾完了，他进了空间，继续修炼去了。

大毛它们五个没有跟着进空间深处，而是趴在透明雾墙边上，看着外面的草原。空间虽然不小，但对于五条大狗来说，还是太小了。它们还是喜欢广阔的天地，喜欢外面的风、外面的草、外面的味道。王建新也不勉强它们，由着它们在雾墙边上待着。

小狐狸也趴在那里，眯着眼睛，看着外面。

王建新盘腿坐在河边，闭上眼睛，运转功法。灵气在体内流转，一圈一圈的，沉稳而有力。丹田里的灵气雾越来越浓，炼气四层的门槛就在眼前，但还差那么一点。

修炼了不知多久，突然听见大毛叫了一声。

不是平时那种汪汪的叫，而是短促的、警惕的、带着警告意味的叫。王建新从修炼中退出，睁开眼睛，站起身，往外看。

外面，月光下，七匹狼正从草原上走过来。它们排成一排，低着头，嗅着地面，慢慢地朝土坯房的方向靠近。领头的那匹狼很大，灰白色的毛，肩膀高耸，脚步无声。

“看来这狼是准备来这找点吃的来了。”王建新看着那几匹狼，心里一点不慌。

这不是找死吗？

他从武器库里挑枪。拿什么好呢？想了想，还是用五六半。AK火力猛，但打狼用不着。SVD威力大，但距离太近，没必要。五六半正好，精度高，威力够，打狼绰绰有余。

自己不吃狼肉，到时把狼皮剥下来，肉不行就送人。谁爱吃谁吃，反正他不吃。

王建新检查好枪支，压满子弹，带着大毛它们一起出了空间。

出了空间，他站在土坯房门口，举枪便射。

“啪——”

第一枪，领头的灰白大狼应声倒下，脑袋开花，四肢抽搐了两下就不动了。

“啪——啪——啪——啪——啪——啪——”

又是六枪，一枪一个。七匹狼，他数着打的，一共开了七枪，七匹狼全部毙命。最近的离他不到二十米，最远的也就五十米，这个距离对他来说，跟打靶子没区别。

枪声在夜空中回荡，传出去老远。

大毛它们五个在王建新开枪的瞬间就冲了出去，汪汪叫着，朝那些倒地的狼扑过去。大毛咬住一匹狼的喉咙，二毛咬住另一匹的脖子，三毛四毛五毛也各自找到了目标，又拖又拽。

Early the next morning, Wang Jianxin patrolled as usual.I rode a horse and took the dog along the barbed wire fence. It was quiet on the other side, not even a footprint.After walking around for a while, there was nothing unusual.

Returning to the adobe house, he began to think about making something delicious.

Recently, we have enough supplies, no shortage of noodles or oil, so we can eat whatever we want.He thought for a while and decided to fry some twists, dumplings and pancakes.These things can be stored easily and can be eaten for several days, saving you the trouble of cooking every time.

Make the dough first.Scoop a few large bowls of white flour, add sugar, eggs, yeast, pour water and mix into a dough.Knead the dough until smooth and cover with a damp cloth.When the noodles were ready, he burned a pot of oil. When the oil temperature came up, the noodles were ready.

Twist is the most difficult to make.Roll the dough into a long strip, twist it at both ends, fold it over and twist it again, and a twist will be formed.It's easy to say, but requires a bit of craftsmanship to do.Wang Jianxin was a cook in his previous life, and he had done this job of frying twists many times, and his hands were no longer raw.Tighten one after another, and soon the whole chopping board was twisted.

The steamed buns take more work.Roll the dough into thin strips, one by one, about the same thickness as chopsticks, and place them in an oil basin to keep them awake.After waking up, pick it up with chopsticks, stretch it straight, and fry it in the oil pan.The noodles are shaped in the oil pan, fried until golden brown, and then taken out, crispy and crispy.

Pancakes are the simplest.Roll the dough into a round cake, make two cuts in the middle, fry in oil pan until both sides are golden brown and puffed up, take it out to control the oil.

I was so busy that I didn't finish it until the afternoon.A big pot of twists was fried, a big pot of steamed buns was fried, and a big pot of fried dough cakes was fried.The whole yard is filled with the aroma of fried noodles, wafting far away.

Wang Jianxin picked up a pancake and took a bite. It was crispy on the outside and soft on the inside. It was very fragrant.I took another twist, it was crunchy and sweet.I tore off another piece of steamed bun, which was so crispy that it fell into pieces.

He gave Da Mao and the others an oil cake each.Five dogs were lying on the ground with fried cakes in their mouths. They were eating so deliciously that their tails were wagging like windmills.The little fox gave it a small piece of twist. The little guy held it in his front paws and nibbled it in small bites. It was a delicious meal.

Wang Jianxin drank milk tea and ate while working, and he didn't eat less.When I was full, I put all the remaining food into the space, put it in the cabinet in the dining room, and stacked it neatly.

After cleaning up, he entered the space and continued to practice.

Da Mao and the other five did not follow him into the depths of the space. Instead, they lay beside the transparent fog wall and looked at the grassland outside.Although the space is not small, it is still too small for five large dogs.They still like the vast world, the wind outside, the grass outside, and the smell outside.Wang Jianxin did not force them, and let them stay by the fog wall.

The little fox was also lying there, squinting his eyes and looking outside.

Wang Jianxin sat cross-legged by the river, closed his eyes, and started practicing the exercises.The spiritual energy circulates in the body, in circles, calmly and powerfully.The spiritual mist in Dantian is getting thicker and thicker, and the threshold of the fourth level of Qi refining is right in front of us, but it is still a little short.

After practicing for an unknown amount of time, I suddenly heard Da Mao shouting.

Not the usual barking bark, but a short, vigilant, warning bark.Wang Jianxin withdrew from practice, opened his eyes, stood up, and looked outside.

Outside, under the moonlight, seven wolves were walking across the grassland.They were lined up in a row, heads lowered, sniffing the ground, and slowly approaching the adobe house.The leading wolf was large, with gray-white fur, high shoulders, and silent footsteps.

"It seems that this wolf is coming here to find some food." Wang Jianxin looked at the wolves without panic at all.

Isn't this courting death?

He picked a gun from the arsenal.What should I take?After thinking about it, I decided to use five or six and a half.AK has strong firepower, but it is not needed for hunting wolves.SVD is powerful, but the distance is too close and unnecessary.Five to six and a half is just right, with high accuracy and enough power, more than enough for hunting wolves.

If you don’t want to eat wolf meat yourself, you will peel off the wolf skin when the time comes. If the meat is no longer good, give it away.Whoever wants to eat can eat it, but he won’t eat it anyway.

Wang Jianxin checked the gun, loaded it with bullets, and took Da Mao with them out of the space.

After leaving the space, he stood at the door of the adobe house, raised his gun and started shooting.

"Pah——"

With the first shot, the leading gray and white wolf fell down with a sudden sound, his head was blown, and his limbs twitched twice and then stopped moving.

"Pah-pah-pah-pah-pah-pah-"

Another six shots, one at a time.He counted the seven wolves he shot, and shot seven times in total, killing all seven wolves.The closest one was less than twenty meters away from him, and the farthest one was only fifty meters away. To him, this distance was no different from shooting at a target.

The sound of gunfire echoed in the night sky and spread far and wide.

Da Mao and the other five rushed out the moment Wang Jianxin fired, barking, and pounced on the wolves that fell to the ground.Big Mao bit the throat of one wolf, Er Mao bit the neck of the other, and each of the three, four, and five wolves found their targets, tugging and tugging.
